en-US.name: Mudsnote
en-US.subtitle: Markdown Notes, Fast Capture
en-US.promotionalText: Capture ideas instantly, then organize, search, read, and edit them as portable Markdown files that stay under your control.
en-US.description:
Mudsnote is a local-first Markdown notebook built for fast capture and everyday organization. Your notes remain ordinary Markdown files in the folder you choose.

CAPTURE WITHOUT FRICTION
• Open Quick Capture from the app, widgets, or App Shortcuts
• Save text, photos, files, scanned documents, drawings, and audio
• Record audio and turn local speech recognition into editable Markdown
• Send new notes to Inbox or a recent file

ORGANIZE LIKE A FULL NOTES APP
• Browse folders, nested folders, pinned notes, tags, smart folders, and attachments
• Sort, move, rename, duplicate, delete, restore, and permanently remove notes
• Use list or gallery views with useful date, folder, pin, and attachment context

READ AND EDIT MARKDOWN DIRECTLY
• Read rendered Markdown by default and tap the note to edit
• Use headings, bold, underline, strikethrough, lists, checklists, quotes, code, and links
• Add photos, files, drawings, scans, and audio without breaking portable relative links
• Expand the editor to full screen and keep unsaved changes protected

FIND ANYTHING
• Search titles, paths, tags, note text, recognized image text, scanned PDFs, and audio transcripts
• Find matches inside the current note and its attachments
• Jump between linked notes and return through navigation history

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Mudsnote has no account, analytics, advertising SDK, or remote note service. The app works with the folder you authorize and keeps your Markdown and attachments as files you can inspect and move.

zh-Hans.name: Mudsnote
zh-Hans.subtitle: Markdown 笔记与快速记录
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 快速记录灵感，再以熟悉的文件夹、标签、搜索与完整编辑体验管理笔记；所有内容仍是由你掌控的 Markdown 文件。
zh-Hans.description:
Mudsnote 是一款本地优先的 Markdown 笔记应用，兼顾快速记录与日常整理。笔记始终保存在你选择的文件夹中，并保持为普通 Markdown 文件。

快速记录
• 从应用、小组件或 App 快捷指令打开快速记录
• 保存文字、照片、文件、扫描文稿、绘图和音频
• 录制音频，并通过本地语音识别生成可编辑的 Markdown
• 将内容发送到收件箱或最近文件

完整整理体验
• 浏览文件夹、嵌套文件夹、置顶笔记、标签、智能文件夹与附件
• 排序、移动、重命名、复制、删除、恢复或永久删除笔记
• 使用列表或画廊视图查看日期、文件夹、置顶与附件信息

直接阅读和编辑 Markdown
• 默认展示渲染后的 Markdown，轻点即可编辑
• 支持标题、粗体、下划线、删除线、列表、清单、引用、代码和链接
• 添加照片、文件、绘图、扫描文稿与音频，同时保留可移植的相对链接
• 支持半屏阅读和全屏编辑，并保护未保存的修改

快速找回内容
• 搜索标题、路径、标签、正文、图片识别文字、扫描 PDF 与音频转写
• 在当前笔记及附件中查找并逐项跳转
• 在关联笔记之间跳转，并通过导航历史返回

隐私优先
Mudsnote 不要求账户，不包含分析、广告 SDK 或远程笔记服务。应用只访问你授权的文件夹，Markdown 与附件始终是可检查、可移动的普通文件。

appReviewNotes: Mudsnote does not require an account or network service. On first launch, choose any writable folder in the system document picker. The app initializes Inbox.md and Attachments inside that authorized folder. Camera, microphone, Photos, and speech permissions are requested only when their corresponding attachment actions are used.
